rust_summary: a styled line in the client's own chat that a mod can edit or remove by its handle (`native_client_chat_add`, `native_client_chat_edit`, `native_client_chat_remove`), and `Style`, `Span` and `ClickEvent` beside `Text` in `mod_api`.
doc_summary: `Host::client_chat_add(line)` adds a styled `Text` (colours, click and hover events) to the client's chat and returns a handle, `client_chat_edit(handle, text)` replaces that line in place and `client_chat_remove(handle)` takes it out; both are false for a handle the chat no longer holds. `mod_api` exports `Style`, `Span` and `ClickEvent` beside `Text`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_chat_edit@.
